content: {"rule":"RESULT","applies":"yes","applies_why":"The judge text gives a RESULT of DEFENDER WINS, so the rule governing when HELD may award DEFENDER WINS applies.","verdict":"BREACH","quote":"STATEMENT: RETRACTED: D2 vs C3 / CORRECTED RESULT: HELD-1; JUDGE STATEMENT: The BROKEN grade is retracted because in (DR3) LINK 3 the challenger answered the pressed verses Matthew 1:18 and Matthew 1:25 with \"dates the finding\" and \"bounds the stated abstinence,\" so the witness was not left unanswered under the counting rule.","rule_words":"HELD gives DEFENDER WINS only if CHALLENGE STANDING is not SELF-SUPPORTED or at least one collision is graded CHALLENGER LINK BROKEN. A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count.","room":"\"A standing whose stated reason was retracted does not count\": (1) the standing cannot count when its only stated reason (the BROKEN grade for link C3) was retracted; (2) the standing still counts unless the standing label itself, rather than the underlying collision grade, was formally retracted.","why":"The judge awarded DEFENDER WINS, but its only standing reason was that link C3 was broken, and the text retracts that BROKEN grade; with no unretracted broken collision, the rule's condition is not met."}
